The '''''Nitsa''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] assigned to the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was assigned to the sector capital planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]].<ref name="LOTE" />
